subtitle: Born in Delhi NCR, PrimeRides empowers discerning travelers, corporate executives, and road-trippers with immaculate, top-tier self-drive vehicles.
mission: To deliver effortless self-drive mobility with absolute transparent pricing, zero hidden penalties, and instant curbside handover across Delhi NCR and Lucknow.
vision: To become India's most trusted luxury self-drive platform, renowned for impeccable vehicle hygiene, transparent policies, and unforgettable journeys.

values.title: Immaculate Vehicle Hygiene
values.description: Every car undergoes a 45-point mechanical inspection and hospital-grade interior sanitization before every key handover.

values.title: Absolute Pricing Transparency
values.description: No surge pricing, no opaque tax surcharges, and instant security deposit release within 48 hours.

values.title: Curbside Terminal Delivery
values.description: Direct key handover at IGI Airport T1/T2/T3, CCS Airport Lucknow, or right to your residence.

values.title: 24/7 Pan-India Roadside Shield
values.description: Dedicated dispatchers and towing assistance active nationwide 365 days a year.
